name: Elemental Magic Arena
creator: anton25131
redeem: Join Elemental Magic Arena on Roblox and stay in the lobby.
Walk to the green codes circle on the ground, next to the Magic Forge anvil.
Type a code into the text box that pops up.
Click Redeem to get your Souls or Diamonds.
notes:
Elemental Magic Arena is a PvP fighting game made by anton25131. You choose an element in the lobby, such as fire, water, ice or lightning, then walk into the arena and battle other players with its spells. Diamonds hidden around the arena unlock new elements, secret elements can drop while you fight, and a fresh element is added every week.

Codes give Souls or Diamonds, which you use to unlock elements and power up your magic. Diamonds are the handiest early, because more elements means more ways to fight. Most codes are like-goal rewards named after the like count, like 150KLIKES, so a new one tends to appear each time the game gains another 10,000 likes. The newest codes are also shown on the board in the lobby codes area.

faq.q: Where do I redeem codes in Elemental Magic Arena?
faq.a: There is no code button on the screen. Walk into the green codes circle on the lobby floor, next to the Magic Forge anvil, and a text box will pop up.
Older like-goal codes like 120KLIKES and 110KLIKES have expired. Usually only the newest few like codes stay active.

faq.q: When does the next Elemental Magic Arena code come out?
faq.a: New codes usually match like-goals, so watch the like count on the game page. When it passes the next 10,000 mark, a new KLIKES code often follows.

tips: Look around the arena for Diamonds between fights. They are the main way to unlock new elements, so grab any you see.
Try a few elements before settling on one. Each element has its own spells, and the one that suits you may not be the first you pick.
Keep fighting, since secret elements can unlock during battles. Staying in the arena longer gives you more chances.
A new element arrives every week, so check back regularly. A fresh element can change which spells work best in the arena.
useRewards: 100MVISITS gives 100 Diamonds, the code to redeem first since Diamonds unlock new elements. The other three codes give 8 Souls in total, which are small amounts, so collect them and spend them once you see what they unlock. Like-goal codes are replaced as the game gains likes, so redeem new ones soon after they appear.
codeChannels: The codes board in the game's lobby, which shows new codes, and like-goals on the game's Roblox page
